+def _radii_for(centers):
+    """Largest feasible radii for fixed centers: wall clearance and pairwise gaps."""
+    n = len(centers)
+    rs = [1.0 - math.hypot(x, y) for x, y in centers]
+    for a in range(n):
+        xa, ya = centers[a]
+        ra = rs[a]
+        for b in range(a + 1, n):
+            d = math.hypot(xa - centers[b][0], ya - centers[b][1])
+            limit = d - rs[b]
+            if limit < ra:
+                ra = limit
+            lb = d - ra
+            if lb < rs[b]:
+                rs[b] = lb
+        rs[a] = ra
+    return rs
+

+def _total_radius(centers):
+    rs = _radii_for(centers)
+    return sum(rs), rs

+def _project_center(cx, cy):
+    """Keep center inside the unit disk (project onto boundary if outside)."""
+    dist = math.hypot(cx, cy)
+    if dist > 1.0:
+        return cx / dist, cy / dist
+    return cx, cy
